$comment: Controls budget (plans/site-v2.md, slice 3b): every interactive element on each built page and its job. Keyed by route pattern (srcRoute in .next/prerender-manifest.json). 'layout' entries apply to every page rendered inside the root layout; a route with "layout": false renders its own document. Entry: {kind, href or name, count (default 1, or "many"), job}. Kinds: link, button, input, select, textarea, summary, iframe, role-button, focusable, plus the classes "prose links" (any link inside .prose) and "scroll regions" (tabindex=0 on a scrolling pre, table or region). Checked by npm run lint:slop -- --built. dialogs lists controls that exist only in the browser after a visitor opens something (the invaders game): never in built HTML, so lint:slop -- --built does not see them; npm run check:pages opens the game on / and checks the rendered dialog against the layout, the route and these entries.
